description: Combined PRD evidence from two isolated Claude Code/Ralph stream worktrees. Verification and PR gate run on this integration branch.

userStories.title: API-key admin writes reject ambiguous JSON request bodies
userStories.description: POST /api/admin/api-keys (Create) and POST /api/admin/api-keys/{id}/rotate (Rotate) now decode through httputil.ReadJSON so concatenated bodies are rejected with 400 InvalidAPIKeyRequest + a 'single JSON value' reason instead of silently dropping the trailing bytes. Extends the P2A-301/302/303 hardening to the API-key surface that mints long-lived bearer credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/admin/api-keys with a body composed of two concatenated JSON objects returns 400 InvalidAPIKeyRequest with reason mentioning 'single JSON value' and persists no APIKey row.
POST /api/admin/api-keys/{id}/rotate with a concatenated body returns 400 InvalidAPIKeyRequest and leaves the predecessor's rotates_at and successor_id untouched (no rotation occurs).
Well-formed Create and Rotate requests continue to succeed end-to-end (201 Created with rawKey returned exactly once; predecessor stamped with rotates_at + successor_id on Rotate).
Rotate with an empty body still uses DefaultAPIKeyRotationGrace (preserves the existing 'no body = 7-day grace' contract).
A BDD integration test TestBDD_APIKeyAdminWritesRejectAmbiguousJSONBody_P2A304 lives in pkg/auth/api_key_handlers_bdd_test.go and covers all four cases above.

userStories.title: Active Saved Search Supports In-Place Update
userStories.scenario: Given an operator has loaded a saved search and drifted the view (search-text/filter/facet/sort/viewMode change), When they click the Update affordance on the originating row, Then the saved search is PUT with the current definition and the Active indicator returns; failed updates surface an inline error without clobbering local edits.
